sections.title: Squad depth (bench impact)
paragraphs: Non-starters with elite per-90 traits add a small squad-depth multiplier to unit ratings (capped at ~5% total; bench cannot dominate outcomes).
Raktim: 4 on bench; 3 with standout quality (+2.6% squad depth boost). Standouts: Viktor Gyökeres, Jonathan Tah, Éder Militão. Boosts — attack +1.0%, creation +0.7%, defence +0.9%.
Moga+Sanmitro: 4 on bench; 3 with standout quality (+3.6% squad depth boost). Standouts: Fabián Ruiz, Anthony Gordon, Benjamin Šeško. Boosts — attack +1.7%, creation +1.3%, defence +0.6%.

sections.title: Expected goals pipeline
paragraphs: The engine splits attack into finishing and chance-creation channels (xA / xG-buildup / xG-chain credit all outfield positions), then applies opponent suppression (back line 54%, mid shield 32%, GK 14%) and midfield battle modifiers.
Raktim raw attack xG: 1.72 finishing + 0.15 creation = 1.86 before suppression. When Moga+Sanmitro defends, suppression factor is 0.849 (DEF 0.51, mid-def 0.31, GK 0.47, transition risk 0.18).
Moga+Sanmitro raw attack xG: 2.13 + 0.22 = 2.36. Raktim suppression when defending: 0.821 (transition risk 0.41).
Midfield battle multipliers: Raktim ×0.994, Moga+Sanmitro ×1.006. Net xG edge: Moga+Sanmitro by 0.51.

sections.title: Defensive structure & transitions
paragraphs: Raktim xGA suppression: 0.754 (base without transition penalty: 0.830). Moga+Sanmitro: 0.719 (base 0.812).
Raktim fullbacks: Achraf Hakimi (RB, exposure 0.34), David Raum (LB, exposure 0.42). Team transition risk 0.406 — high attacking fullbacks increase counter vulnerability when midfield cover is thin.

Moga+Sanmitro fullbacks: Rúben Dias (RB, exposure 0.12), Jurriën Timber (LB, exposure 0.21). Team transition risk 0.182 — high attacking fullbacks increase counter vulnerability when midfield cover is thin.
Opposition wing threat vs leaky fullbacks: Moga+Sanmitro's wide attack gets a +2.9% xG edge (winger threat 0.69, Raktim transition risk 0.41).

Press vs build-up: Raktim's press trims Moga+Sanmitro's chance creation by ~9.0% (press 0.47 vs resistance 0.15). Press vs build-up: Moga+Sanmitro's press trims Raktim's chance creation by ~7.8% (press 0.43 vs resistance 0.20).
